scientific_integrity: Exact derivation from four edge parametrizations, angular convexity, and integration; no independent validation or claim of historical exclusivity.
scientific_limitations: Only Euclidean parallelograms; no theorem for all convex curves.
The upper envelope for p>2 is a supremum approached as area tends to zero.
Older unindexed equivalent formulas may exist; priority is provisional.
Exact perimeter-normalized population integrals, not finite-sample estimates.
title: Sharp perimeter-normalized radial moments of centered parallelograms
